hints: The original started from a form submission; pass the form fields as run inputs.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect apify: `cdecli credential create -n "apify" -p apify --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## What this does

Somebody types a company name or a registration number into a form. The workflow reads that company straight out of the country's official business register and answers one question, which is whether the company is still active.

Seven registers are covered and all of them return the same field names, so nothing downstream has to know which country it got.

Czechia (ARES), Estonia (Ariregister), Finland (PRH), France (Annuaire des Entreprises), Norway (Bronnoysund), Poland (MF VAT list), Slovakia (RPO).

## Setup

1. Install the Apify node. It is verified by n8n, so it works on Cloud and on self-hosted.
2. Add your Apify API key in the node credentials. A free Apify account is enough to start.
3. Open the form URL on the trigger node.

The Actor is gubidonius/company-registry-lookup. It reads the government API of each
country directly, so there is no login to any register and no personal data is returned.
